title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1969-03-02
lineage: Multi-track reel master > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Stunning soundboard recording captures a high‑energy Fillmore run with a smoking Dark Star, The Eleven and an epic Other One, while the crystal‑clear mix lets every instrument shine.
ai_review.review: The three‑disc set delivers one of the band’s peak‑period performances – dark, adventurous jams like Dark Star, The Eleven and a marathon Other One are highlighted as “smoking” and “telepathically beautiful.”  Reviewers repeatedly praise the lossless soundboard source for its clarity, balanced vocals and vivid instrument separation, making it a must‑have despite a few minor track‑splitting quirks.  Overall the show feels high‑energy with only a handful of weaker moments (e.g., a sloppy St. Stephen).

ai_rating.rationale: Over 30 reviews, all but one rate the show 5 stars and praise both performance and sound quality; weighting favors a superb musical showing with excellent recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Lossless SBD files described as crisp, clear, great vibes, balanced vocals (Bob left, Jerry right) and no major audio flaws; only occasional complaints about track splitting.

poor_songs: St. Stephen (noted as sloppy by one reviewer)
Doin' That Rag (called one of the worst)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong opening with Dark Star, sustained high energy through The Eleven and Alligator>Caution; a few mid‑show dips but overall a cohesive, telepathic flow that builds to an epic Other One.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for perfect tone, magical counterpoint with Tom Constanten, and staying on the same wavelength with Phil throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Highlighted as locked in with Jerry; his bass work described as tightly woven into the jams.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals noted as well‑balanced (Bobby in left ear) and generally solid, though no specific solo remarks.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten’s playing called “spot on” and later praised for tender, playful keyboard layers throughout the performance.
band_member_comments.Drums: The drum section described as sublime and a highlight of the night.
